skills/claudemy.description: Turn any topic into a short audio course. Researches the topic on the web, works out what most good sources agree on and where they split, then writes and renders a broken-down set of 2-minute two-host audio lessons, each with a one-screen card and one small thing to try. Can also build the class from one specific person's work when asked.
